title: β-cyclodextrin-functionalized acetylene black nanocomposite electrode with enhanced host–guest enrichment for ultralow-level detection of niclosamide
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17784-17800
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09466F, Paper
Open Access

Rima Heider Al Omari, Soumya V. Menon, Subhashree Ray, Talal Aziz Qassem, Gunjan Garg, Renu Sharma, Dilbar Urazbaeva, Sabokhat Sadikova, Sobhan Mirizadeh
A β-cyclodextrin/acetylene black modified glassy carbon electrode enables sensitive electrochemical detection of niclosamide using DPV, offering a wide linear range, low detection limit, and excellent selectivity.
